easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.
